name: Womanhood
overview: Scripture reveals that womanhood is part of God's intentional creation, made in His image alongside man, establishing equal value and purpose (Genesis 1:27). The fall introduced sorrow and a complex relational dynamic between husband and wife, marked by both struggle and responsibility (Genesis 3:16). Yet God also blesses womanhood with the joy of motherhood and the ability to nurture a godly household (Psalms 113:9; Proverbs 14:1). Wisdom and discretion are prized qualities in a woman, reflecting her influence on the stability and honor of her home (Proverbs 11:22; Proverbs 14:1).
